svg.title: Equipment lending station, 8 mm poplar, 300 × 250 × 150 mm
svg.desc: Equipment lending station made from eight 8 mm poplar plywood panels. Body 300 by 250 by 150 mm; openings 170 by 234 mm and 106 by 234 mm. Hinged door 166 by 230 mm with a handle; hinged electronics cover 102 by 230 mm with a knob. Each panel has two metal hinges, one magnetic catch and 2 mm gaps. Front, interior and mirrored rear views. Servo latch, door contact, Nano ESP32, DS3231 clock, fixed buzzer below the servo and rear lower power inlet. Mounting positions are conceptual and need CAD and assembly validation.
svg.text: Front panels omitted · wiring simplified: red 5 V, black GND
Mirrored; power enters behind the electronics

g.text: 2 Window with light pipe for the RGB LED
5 Door contact on the divider, magnet in the door
6 Nano on mini breadboard, USB-C down
10 Buzzer below Nano, behind sound openings
8 USB-C cable to its screw terminal
7 DS3231 clock, LIR2032 to the front
9 MG90S servo; latch through the divider
11 Six connectors: four power, two door contact
13 DC inlet in the back panel
15 Two magnetic catches, one per panel

svg.text: Poplar plywood 8 mm, cut to size
Printed: handle, knob, mounts and latch
Body 300 × 250 × 150 mm · 8 mm poplar plywood · openings: equipment 170 × 234 mm; electronics 106 × 234 mm.
Door 166 × 230 mm; cover 102 × 230 mm · 2 mm gaps · usable depth about 134 mm · verify mounting positions in CAD.

Local revision 2026-10-22: two hinged front panels, four metal hinges, door handle and cover knob, and two magnetic catches; comparison overlay removed; fixed buzzer position retained.

Local revision 2026-10-22 (Claude): wall-side hinge leaves drawn inside the side walls, so only the panel leaf and knuckle show from the front; clock module labelled DS3231; metal hinges added to the legend.

Local revision 2026-10-22 (Claude): light pipe, Bluetooth mark and buzzer openings on the electronics cover share one vertical centre axis with equal spacing; Nano on its breadboard centred behind the light pipe, DS3231 beside it and the buzzer moved onto the same axis below the servo.

Local revision 2026-10-22 (Claude): simplified wiring added to view B. Lever connectors: 5 V and GND at the bottom, two for the door contact (signal, GND) near the divider top. Nano pins: servo D9, door contact D2, buzzer D3, DS3231 SDA A4, SCL A5, VCC 3V3. DC inlet moved to sit behind the jack.
2026-10-22: Six PCT-213 connectors shown; buzzer D3 and Nano GND via breadboard. Front LED, sound openings and Bluetooth symbol share x=302.9.
